## The question

[How to generate this symbol~ in pdf using latex](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/28309/how-to-generate-this-symbol-in-pdf-using-latex), asked by veda on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-11-29; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> > **Possible Duplicate:**  
> > [URL with tilde character?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/10858/url-with-tilde-character)  
>
> <!-- End of automatically inserted text -->
>
> How to generate this line in pdf using latex.
>
> > http://www.google.com/~find/
>
> How can I create **~find** in latex.
>
> I tried `\~\ find` which creates only
>
> > ~ find
>
> How can I do that....
:::

```latex
\usepackage{url}
```

Then `\url{http://www.google.com/~find}`  See also [this question](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/3568/how-does-one-insert-a-url-correctly) on the TeX StackExchange.
